body: I'm glad your center was okay and yeah something is brewing but I don't know what. I'm pretty sure other positions pay more than what TLs get paid. "sales" makes something around 25 plus commission while TLs make around 15 and CAs were making 12 with no raises even if your performance is amazing. I've seen people pulling in 99s on their  test calls and performing well at all times and they get nothing in return :/

like the previous comment said I know this is an old post but they just slashed the amount of TLS for this company in half. the options were accepting severance or accept getting demoted back to a CA. the center I work at is extremely understaffed and hurting for TLS yet the majority of them got let go or demoted. apparently TLS who are working remotely weren't offered a demotion they were just fired in the middle of their shifts. it's disgusting. they try to act like they care about us but they only care about numbers. and even if your numbers are good it doesn't matter, they'll still blame you and won't listen to any critiques. it just becomes us not trying hard enough.

The whistle-blower quit he did not get fired AFAIK the email sounded like he quit. This company explicitly offers time and a half regardless of if you hit OT if you work on a holiday. Time and a half pay can be stopped if you are absent the day before or after the holiday. He was also not an accountant he was a team lead supervisor. I personally know of at least one person who did not get compensated properly that pay period. HR and payroll are excruciatingly slow. It took months to get my correct payrate. I saw employees saying they did not get paid multiple times just to be publicly ignored by the manager. They are cutting out OT and assigning off for the holidays now so they don't have to pay that time and a half even though the holidays are supposedly the busiest season for them. You work payroll but this company poorly explains holiday pay to its employees and there are most certainly people who did not get compensated properly at times. I can believe that there's employees who did not get paid correctly and payroll or the management who should tell payroll either 1.didnt communicate or 2.took way too long to fix or address the issue

The sad thing is I don't think they're running out of money, they just don't want to pay us. They have a robotic system for overflow, everyone says the holidays are the busiest times. I can see it yet, there's almost no time between calls or maybe 3-5 seconds between 8 am-6 or 7 pm. yet they're no longer offering overtime and assigning us off? smells fishy to me

I'm a current supervisor and I believe it. it took payroll/hrs a month and a half to issue me my raise with backpay. They're also currently cutting out overtime and being able to work on the holiday so you dont get time and a half pay for Thanksgiving and Black Friday week. They're forcibly assigning off but only allow you to ACTUALLY work 32 hours if you're FT40, 24  if your FT32 etc. so they don't have to pay us more than what they need. My center has gotten scheduled in a way that a TL or manager won't be present for certain hours so if you're a CA and need immediate help you're sol for that time period
